svg.title: A silent upstream bug filled the disk; a one-line patch removed it
svg.desc: Four steps of an engineering incident and a log-scale chart: a one-line upstream bug made the simulator write about 550 megabytes of unused trace files per evaluation; after a patch it writes 144 kilobytes.
